samaQuran.heroDesc: A value we hope to carry for a lifetime.
samaQuran.maknaDesc1: For us, being with the Quran is not about memorizing 30 juz, 20 juz, or even 10 juz.
samaQuran.maknaDesc2: Sama Quran is about making the Quran a part of our life.
samaQuran.maknaClosing: You don't have to wait until you're perfect to start being with the Quran.
samaQuran.perjalananTitle:
Whatever Your Journey,
Stay With the Quran.
samaQuran.perjalananDesc1: We are all walking a different journey.
samaQuran.perjalananDesc2: Some are studying, working, building dreams, bettering themselves, or trying to mend a life that feels heavy.
samaQuran.perjalananDesc3: But whatever it is, one thing must never be left behind: never let the journey take us away from the Quran.
samaQuran.perjalananQuote: Because in the end, it is not only about how we live our life. It is also about how we close it.
samaQuran.hidupTitle:
Live with the Quran.
Return with the Quran.
samaQuran.hidupDesc1: That is the hope we carry through the name Samaqu.
samaQuran.hidupDesc2: May Sama Quran be more than a brand name — may it be a value that lives within us, and within anyone who wishes to carry it.
samaQuran.hidupDesc3: We want this value to be preserved not only through what we say, but through what we do.
samaQuran.ctaDesc: Living with it. And hoping to return with it.

garansiRetur.heroDesc: We understand that buying clothes online can sometimes make us hesitant.
garansiRetur.heroBullet1: What if the size doesn't fit?
garansiRetur.heroBullet2: What if the item received doesn't match?
garansiRetur.heroBullet3: Or what if there's a shipping error?
garansiRetur.heroClosing: That's why we're committed to providing a comfortable and safe shopping experience. If any issues arise that are our responsibility, we'll help resolve them as best we can.
garansiRetur.garansiDesc: We provide warranty for the following conditions.
garansiRetur.garansi1Desc: For example, the product, color, or size received doesn't match your order. We'll exchange it at no additional cost.
garansiRetur.garansi2Desc: If there are manufacturing defects that passed Quality Control, we'll inspect and assist with the exchange process according to applicable terms.
garansiRetur.garansi2Note: Shipping costs fully covered by SAMAQU.
garansiRetur.garansi3Desc: If the size received doesn't match what was ordered, we'll help with the size exchange process as long as stock is available.
garansiRetur.garansi3Note: Shipping costs borne by the buyer.
garansiRetur.returDesc: To ensure the return process goes smoothly, please make sure the following requirements are met.
garansiRetur.retur1: Product has never been used or washed.
garansiRetur.retur2: Labels and tags are still intact.
garansiRetur.retur4: Request submitted within 3 days of receiving the product.
garansiRetur.cara2: Explain the issue and include photos or videos as evidence.
garansiRetur.cara3: Our team will inspect and provide the best solution.
garansiRetur.cara4: If approved, we'll provide product shipping instructions.
garansiRetur.noReturDesc: To maintain product quality for all customers, we cannot accept returns for the following conditions.
garansiRetur.noRetur3: Wrong size due to not following the size guide
garansiRetur.noRetur4: Product has been used or washed
garansiRetur.ctaDesc1: If you still have questions about warranty or returns, don't hesitate to contact our team. We'll be happy to help.
garansiRetur.ctaDesc2: Because for us, your satisfaction and comfort are an important part of the SAMAQU journey.
